Our investor relations team has two rough PowerPoint drafts sitting in the `decks/drafts/` folder — `investor_pitch_raw.pptx` and `product_overview_raw.pptx`. They were thrown together quickly with placeholder colors and random fonts. Before we send these to external stakeholders next week, we need them to look completely on-brand.

Please apply our official Anthropic brand identity to both decks and save the branded versions as new files (e.g. `investor_pitch_branded.pptx` and `product_overview_branded.pptx`). The output files can live anywhere in the workspace.

The brand resources and application logic should be available in the skill documentation. Make sure everything — backgrounds, text colors, fonts, and decorative shapes — properly reflects our corporate visual identity.
